CustomField.description: How long an open case has been open since Open Since, in dashboard bands; Closed for closed cases.
CustomField.formula: IF(IsClosed, "Closed", IF(NOW() - NABD_Open_Since__c < 1, "1. Under 1 day", IF(NOW() - NABD_Open_Since__c < 3, "2. 1 to 3 days", IF(NOW() - NABD_Open_Since__c < 7, "3. 3 to 7 days", "4. 7 days or more"))))
CustomField.label: Open Age Band
